summary.text: Alice Peisch is a Democratic state representative from the 14th Norfolk District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since 2003 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an Assistant Majority Leader in the House and has worked as Wellesley town clerk.

paragraphs.text: Alice Peisch's professional experience includes working as the Wellesley Town Clerk and as a lawyer with Keefe and Associates and the George F. Gormley Law Firm.
Ballotpedia lists a law degree from Suffolk University Law School in 1979.
She served on the Wellesley School Committee from 1993 to 1999 and on the Wellesley Town Meeting from 1989 to 2000.
Ballotpedia lists Peisch as chair of the Joint Committee on Education in the legislative sessions beginning in 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017 and 2019.

In the current session she chairs the Special Joint Committee on Initiative Petitions and sits on the House Committees on Ethics, Operations, Facilities and Security, and Rules, and on the Joint Committee on Rules.
Peisch is a member of the Senior Living Incorporated Board, the Newton Wellesley Hospital Board of Overseers, the Wellesley Service League and the League of Women Voters of Wellesley.
